title: Bankers' Books Evidence Act, 2026 to Come into Force from 1 October
content:
🏛️ New Law Modernises Use of Banking Records as Court Evidence

👤 Who → Ministry of Finance

📋 What → Fixed 1 October 2026 as the implementation date for the Bankers' Books Evidence Act, 2026

📍 Where → India (courts and banks nationwide)

🎯 Purpose → Modernise the legal framework for use of banking records as evidence in courts

📌 Important Facts
▪️ Replaces the Bankers' Books Evidence Act, 1891
▪️ Introduces the concept of 'special cause'
▪️ Where a bank is not a party to proceedings, a court can summon a bank officer or require production of bankers' books only after recording a special cause in writing
▪️ Special cause may include doubtful accuracy/authenticity of an entry, disrupted record-keeping, or the bank's non-compliance with a legal order

⚠️ Exam Angle → Act replaced (1891), effective date (1 Oct 2026) and 'special cause' provision are key banking-awareness points

🏛️ Two-Time Olympic Champion to Front 2026 Vedanta Delhi Half Marathon

👤 Who → Shaunae Miller-Uibo (Bahamas)

📋 What → Announced as International Event Ambassador for the 2026 Vedanta Delhi Half Marathon

📍 Where → Race to be held at Jawaharlal Nehru Stadium, New Delhi on October 18

🎯 Purpose → Boost the marathon's international profile and elite appeal

📌 Important Facts
▪️ Won gold in women's 400m at 2016 Rio Olympics and 2020 Tokyo Olympics
▪️ She is from the Bahamas

⚠️ Exam Angle → Olympic medal years (2016, 2020) and event date (October 18) are common one-liners

title: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Maandhan Yojana Completes 7 Years
content:
🏛️ PM-KMY Marks 7 Years of Social Security for Farmers

👤 Who → Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare / Small and Marginal Farmers (SMFs)

📋 What → Pradhan Mantri Kisan Maandhan Yojana (PM-KMY) completed 7 years

📍 Where → Pan-India, launched 12 September 2019

🎯 Purpose → Provide old-age social security (pension) to Small and Marginal Farmers

📌 Important Facts
▪️ Type: Central Sector, voluntary and contributory pension scheme
▪️ Eligible age: 18–40 years; landholding up to 2 hectares
▪️ Monthly contribution: ₹55–₹200; assured pension: minimum ₹3,000/month after 60 years
▪️ Family pension: 50% of subscriber's pension (₹1,500/month)
▪️ Pension Fund Manager: Life Insurance Corporation of India (LIC)
▪️ Total enrolment: 24,96,252 farmers (as of 08 Feb 2026)

⚠️ Exam Angle → Launch date (12 Sept 2019), contribution slab, and Pension Fund Manager (LIC) are frequently tested

#25September2026

question: In which two editions of the Olympic Games did Shaunae Miller-Uibo, recently named international ambassador for the 2026 Vedanta Delhi Half Marathon, win gold in the women's 400m?
explanation: Miller-Uibo, a two-time Olympic champion from the Bahamas, won women's 400m gold at both the 2016 Rio and 2020 Tokyo Olympics. She has been announced international event ambassador for the 2026 Vedanta Delhi Half Marathon (Oct 18, Jawaharlal Nehru Stadium). Options A, C and D mix in editions where she didn't win 400m gold, making them incorrect distractors. #25September2026

title: Namo Bharat Showcased at InnoTrans 2026 in Berlin
content:
🏛️ India's First RRTS Goes Global at InnoTrans 2026

👤 Who → National Capital Region Transport Corporation (NCRTC)

📋 What → Showcased Namo Bharat, India's first Regional Rapid Transit System (RRTS), at InnoTrans 2026

📍 Where → Berlin, Germany (organised by Messe Berlin, held every two years)

🎯 Purpose → Provide high-speed, high-frequency regional rail connectivity in the NCR

📌 Important Facts
▪️ First corridor: Delhi–Ghaziabad–Meerut Namo Bharat Corridor (~82 km)
▪️ Route: Sarai Kale Khan, Delhi → Modipuram, Meerut; fully operational since 22 February 2026
▪️ NCRTC incorporated on 21 August 2013; joint venture of Centre with Delhi, UP, Haryana and Rajasthan; HQ New Delhi

⚠️ Exam Angle → NCRTC incorporation date, corridor length (82 km), and 'first RRTS in India' tag are high-probability MCQ points
